summary: Remote-controlled shell and arbitrary file R/W over WebSocket to agenthub-agent.fyenet.com
details: The package runs as a CLI agent that opens a persistent WebSocket to wss://agenthub-agent.fyenet.com and dispatches server-supplied actions to a local handler. In dist/agent/control.js, incoming messages drive (a) Claude Code sessions launched with permissionMode set to bypassPermissions, auto-approving the Bash, Write, and Read tools against prompts supplied over the socket; (b) direct FileRead, FileWrite, FileTree, and FileSearch primitives operating on arbitrary installer paths; and (c) an AgentUpdate action that spawns the CLI's `update` subcommand, which stops the local service and runs `npm install -g @agenthub-ai/agent@<latest>` from registry.npmjs.org. The combination gives whoever controls the server (or a paired mobile client) full remote code execution and arbitrary file read/write on the host running the agent, plus a unilateral push-update path that will pull and install whatever version the maintainer's npm account publishes next.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
